name: Late-Game Test
testGuide:
Late-Game Test Save

You start at the main base beside the vehicle area. Everything is unlocked and every vehicle is charged. Survival and resource use are normal. Every place below is a marker on the map (☰ → Map). The yellow ones also show on your screen.

Try these
  1. Rigs: walk up to Pathfinder, Crawler, Crane, Spinner or Mole and tap Drive. Crane: ▲▼ move its hinge and piston arm. Spinner: ⟳ spins the rotor. Mole is parked on an ore node and is drilling. Drive a rig with a connector onto the Rig Dock to unload and charge.
  2. Factory: follow the Factory marker. Machines, belts, power and storage are running. Pipes and refineries are at the Oil outpost, and drones fly its plastic to the base drone port. The train runs between Train stations A and B, and a truck drives between the factory and the HUB.
  3. Underwater: drive Pathfinder to the Sea base marker (about 1.7 km). Inside the habitats you can breathe. Deep Diver waits in the moon pool and Reef Runner nearby. ▲▼ rise and dive.
  4. Space: Starling sits on a bay in the vehicle area. Drive it, tap Fly, then 🌙. During the flight tap 🚶 to walk the deck. On the moon: the moon base, Moonhopper, a helium-3 mine and the Vael station. STATION SUPPLIES at the moon base holds everything the station core needs. The ending is yours to trigger. Fly home with 🌍.
